command_binding.transport: Fresh actual pinned VM process stdout NDJSON. No native observer, platform adapter, wrapper or SDK-generated substitute.

allow.guest_command_sha256: SHA256 of exact validated guest command bytes read from executing module memory
allow.native_operation_id: Actual 16-byte UUID returned by native action SendGoal; lowercase 32 hexadecimal characters

command_binding.session_semantics: VM producer binds current executing module instance and verified permission owner to actual imported call sequence, exact adapter/grant digests, guest command bytes and native accepted goal. Independent native GetResult and fresh state must match that actual UUID.
command_binding.replay_protection: Fresh parent-generated run ID plus actual producing VM PID/birth/executable/cgroup, event monotonic time after this run start. Native UUID alone is insufficient.

finite_evidence.scope: Exact VM-owner private R11 loop only; no permission for a new public SDK run

sensor_status: Separate actual inbound native payload-to-module-memory receipt production contract remains required; v1 generic completion explicitly BLOCKED_SENSOR_RUNTIME_PRODUCER_CONTRACT_UNAVAILABLE_V1
prohibited_substitutes: Copying observer UUID into a VM field
Echo server or host-precomputed guest digest
Reconstructed field from an unrelated native session

full_wasm_requirement.business_execution: All application queries, callbacks, state feedback and sensor processing execute in Wasm via the controlled VM host
full_wasm_requirement.native_sdk_clients: Forbidden in public acceptance; confirmed implementations physically quarantined
full_wasm_requirement.required_implementation: Manifest may declare status BLOCKED with diagnostic and nonempty requirements; omit executable driver; all mandatory scenarios remain non-success and no scene starts
